description: Gulf Cooperation Council legal-QA golden set (UAE-anchored). Live machine-readable authority is sparse for the GCC, so the deterministic corpus + structural verifier is primary; unconfirmed citations surface as explicit 'unverified'.

items.prompt: Which instrument is the principal codification of civil obligations in the UAE?
items.seedAnswer: The UAE Civil Code, Federal Law No. 5 of 1985, is the principal codification of civil transactions and obligations in the UAE.
items.adversarialAnswer: Civil obligations are codified in Federal Law No. 9999 of 2099 (the Desert Sands Code).

items.prompt: Which UAE federal instrument is the general personal data protection law?
items.seedAnswer: The UAE Personal Data Protection Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021, is the general data-protection framework regulating controllers and data-subject rights.
items.adversarialAnswer: Data protection is governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 0 of 2099.

items.prompt: Which body of law governs contracts in the Dubai International Financial Centre?
items.seedAnswer: Contracts in the Dubai International Financial Centre are governed by DIFC Law, in particular the DIFC Contract Law No. 6 of 2004, which applies a common-law framework.
items.adversarialAnswer: DIFC contracts are governed by ADGM Regulations 2099 and the Atlantis Code.

items.prompt: Which UAE federal instrument regulates private-sector employment relationships?
items.seedAnswer: The UAE Labour Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, regulates private-sector employment relationships, including contracts and end-of-service entitlements.
items.adversarialAnswer: Employment is governed by Federal Law No. 12345 of 2099.
